description: Address v2 review feedback: daily-loss circuit breaker, adapter connection, credential encryption, webhook API key auth
steps: Create src/lib/crypto.ts with AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt utility using ENCRYPTION_KEY env var
Fix daily-loss circuit breaker in webhook by computing actual daily loss from Trade table
Fix follower adapter connection in webhook by calling connect() with credentials before returning
Add webhookSecret field to CopyGroup in Prisma schema and auto-generate on group creation
Add API key fallback auth to the webhook route - accept x-api-key header matching group webhookSecret
Update account creation/update routes to encrypt credentials on save
Update sync and webhook routes to decrypt credentials before use
Write tests for crypto utility, daily loss calculation, and webhook auth
acceptance_criteria: Daily loss circuit breaker computes actual loss from Trade table for today
Follower adapters are connected with credentials before placeTrade is called
src/lib/crypto.ts provides encrypt/decrypt functions using AES-256-GCM
Account credentials are encrypted before storage
Credentials are decrypted before use in sync and webhook routes
Webhook accepts x-api-key header as alternative to session auth
CopyGroup model has nullable webhookSecret field
